nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive project documentation covering setup, Python library and OpenAI-compatible server usage, Docker deployment, rate limiting, Cloudflare clearance, concurrency testing, troubleshooting, and project layout.

nodes.name: RESOURCES.md
